# ms: # A second turn in the same process, interrupted with Escape while the model was
# Interrupt fires and carries reason=cancelled. Cancellation is therefore
# first-class in Kimi, unlike OpenCode (which needs an error class name to tell
# a cancelled turn from a failed one) and unlike Claude Code (which emits
# nothing at all). No Stop follows it, so Interrupt is the only event that
# returns the pane to idle on this path -- which is exactly why upstream's table
# maps it to idle and why dropping that row would latch the pane on working.
